# 1. Setup

```{r setup}
# Note: this Rmd runs from models/, so every path below goes through here::here()

library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
```

# 2. Config

```{r config}
DATASET <- "extended_data_self"   # "main_data_official" / "main_data_self" / "extended_data_official" / "extended_data_self" 

HORIZONS <- c(1, 3, 6, 12)
OOS_START <- if (grepl("self", DATASET)) as.Date("2001-02-01") else as.Date("2012-02-01")
WINDOW <- 240          # NULL: (nrow - nprev); integer: fixed window size

N_LAGS <- 4
N_PCS <- 4
CV_N_VAL <- 50          # validation points at end of each window
RETUNE_EVERY <- 12        # retune lambda every 12 months (1 year)

SEED <- 4308
OUT_DIR <- "results/lasso"
```

# 2a. Set seed
```{r}
set.seed(SEED)
```

# 3. Load data

```{r load-data}
df <- readRDS(here::here("data","processed", paste0(DATASET, ".rds")))
df <- df[!is.na(df$inflation_mom),]
dates <- df$date

pred_cols <- grep("^(CAN|US)_", names(df), value = TRUE)
pred_cols <- setdiff(pred_cols, "US_ACOGNO")

Y <- as.matrix(df[, c("inflation_mom", pred_cols)])
Y <- zoo::na.locf(Y, na.rm = FALSE)

dim(Y); anyNA(Y); colnames(Y)[1]
```

# 4. Out-of-sample split and feasibility

```{r oos-feasibility}
# Expect: nprev = 174 (official) or 306 (self), W = 240, L = 186 at h = 1 and 153 at h = 12

nprev <- sum(dates >= OOS_START)

# check if WINDOW is integer
if (!is.null(WINDOW)) {
  keep <- tail(seq_len(nrow(Y)), nprev + WINDOW)
  Y <- Y[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  dates <- dates[keep]
}

# rolling window size
W <- nrow(Y) - nprev

# CV training length per horizon
L <- W - 3 * HORIZONS - N_LAGS + 3 - CV_N_VAL

if (min(L) < 100) stop ("CV training length too short: min(L) = ", min(L))

nprev; W; L
```

# 5. Functions

```{r functions}
source(here::here("models", "func-lasso.R"))
```

# 6. Timing and CV checks

```{r timing-checks}
Y_time <- Y[1:240, ]

dim(Y_time); anyNA(Y_time); colnames(Y_time)[1]

lag <- 1; indice <- 1

Y_time <- Y_time[1:(nrow(Y_time) - lag + 1), ]
  
# compute principal components to add as predictors
comp <- prcomp(scale(Y_time))
  
# augment predictors by the first 4 PCs
Y2 <- cbind(Y_time, comp$x[,1:4])
  
# create 4 lags + forecast horizon shift (=lag option)
aux <- embed (Y2, 4 + lag)
  
# align Y for missing data due to lags
y <- aux[,indice]
  
# lags of Y (predictors) corresponding to forecast horizon
X <- aux[,-c(1:(ncol(Y2)*lag))]
  
# retrieve last 4 observations of the window
X.out <- tail(aux,1)[1:ncol(X)]

nrow(X); ncol(X)

full <- glmnet::glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1)
L <- cv_indices(n = nrow(X), h = lag, V = 50)$L
system.time({pos <- cv_lambda(X, y, h = lag, V = 50, lambda.grid = full$lambda)})
best.lambda <- full$lambda[pos]
L; best.lambda
```

# 8. Full run

```{r full-run}
# store one result per horizon, named "h1", "h3", "h6", "h12"
results <- vector("list", length(HORIZONS))
names(results) <- paste0("h", HORIZONS)

dir.create(here::here(OUT_DIR), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (h in HORIZONS) {
  cat("horizon", h, "\n")
  results[[paste0("h", h)]] <- lasso.rolling.window(Y, nprev, dates, indice = 1, lag = h, retune.every = RETUNE_EVERY)
  saveRDS(results, here::here(OUT_DIR, paste0("results_lasso_", DATASET, ".rds")))
}

sapply(results, function(r) r$errors)
```

# 9. Checks

```{r check-length}
# check forecast shape
# forecasts: nprev rows, no NAs, for LASSO and Post-LASSO at every h
cat("Checks for forecast shape", "\n")
for (h in HORIZONS) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(r$pred), c("lasso", "post")),
            nrow(r$pred) == nprev,
            !anyNA(r$pred),
            length(r$actual) == nprev, !anyNA(r$actual),
            length(r$target_date) == nprev, length(r$origin_date) == nprev,
            !anyNA(r$lambda))
  stopifnot(all(diff(r$pos)[seq_along(diff(r$pos)) %% RETUNE_EVERY != 0] == 0))
  cat("h =", h, ": forecasts OK\n")
}

# month index (year * 12 + month), so the gap is counted in calendar months
month_index <- function(d) {
  lt <- as.POSIXlt(d)
  return(lt$year * 12 + lt$mon)
}
```


```{r check-month-index}
cat("Checks for month index", "\n")
for (h in HORIZONS) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]
  stopifnot(inherits(r$target_date, "Date"),
            # origin is h months before target at every row
            all(month_index(r$target_date) - month_index(r$origin_date) == h),
            # targets are consecutive months and are the last nprev dates
            all(diff(month_index(r$target_date)) == 1),
            identical(r$target_date, tail(dates, nprev)))
  cat("h =", h, ": dates OK\n")
}
```


```{r check-target}
cat("Check actual = target", "\n")
for (h in HORIZONS) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]
  
  # look up each origin date in the raw data
  row <- match(r$origin_date, df$date)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(row))
  
  # realised target stored at the origin row must equal the stored actual
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(df[[paste0("target_h", h)]][row]),
                             as.numeric(r$actual), tolerance = 1e-10)))
  cat("h =", h, ": actual matches target_h", h, "\n", sep = "")
}
```


```{r refit-check}
# refit by hand at 3 random origins per horizon
set.seed(1)
indice <- 1
tol <- 1e-8

for (h in HORIZONS) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]
  
  for (k in sort(sample(nprev, 3))) {
    # window used at iteration k (same rows as lasso.rolling.window)
    end.row <- nrow(Y) - nprev - 1 + k
    W <- Y[k:end.row, ]
    
    # window ends h - 1 rows after the origin, so drop them
    stopifnot(dates[end.row - (h - 1)] == r$origin_date[k])
    W <- W[1:(nrow(W) - h + 1), ]
    n.w <- nrow(W)
    
    # PCs re-estimated on this window
    pcs <- prcomp(scale(W))$x[, 1:4]
    Y2 <- cbind(W, pcs)
    
    # build design row by row
    # target is the value h rows after s
    s.idx <- 4:(n.w - h)
    X.hand <- t(sapply(s.idx, function(s) as.numeric(t(Y2[s - 0:3, ]))))
    y.hand <- Y2[s.idx + h, indice]
    
    # predictors at the forecast origin (newest four rows of the window)
    x.out <- as.numeric(t(Y2[n.w - 0:3, ]))
    
    # LASSO refit, predicted at the stored lambda
    fit <- glmnet(X.hand, y.hand, alpha = 1)
    lam <- r$lambda[k]
    stopifnot(min(abs(fit$lambda - lam)) < 1e-10)
    beta.hand <- as.numeric(coef(fit, s = lam))
    pred.lasso <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = matrix(x.out, nrow = 1), s = lam))
    
    # Post-LASSO by hand with lm(), following the support rules
    support <- which(beta.hand[-1] != 0)
    if (length(support) == 0) {
      pred.post <- mean(y.hand)
    } else if (length(support) > nrow(X.hand) / 2) {
      pred.post <- pred.lasso
    } else {
      dat <- data.frame(y = y.hand, X.hand[, support, drop = FALSE])
      ols <- lm(y ~ ., data = dat)
      b <- coef(ols)
      b[is.na(b)] <- 0
      pred.post <- sum(b * c(1, x.out[support]))
    }
    
    # match stored forecasts, coefficients and support size
    stopifnot(abs(pred.lasso - r$pred[k, "lasso"]) < tol,
              abs(pred.post - r$pred[k, "post"]) < tol,
              max(abs(beta.hand - r$coef[k, ])) < tol,
              length(support) == r$support[k, "size"])
    cat("h =", h, "| origin", format(r$origin_date[k]), ": hand refit matches\n")
  }
}
```

# 10. Save

```{r save-forecasts}
# long table: one row per target date, horizon and model
forecast_long <- NULL

for (h in HORIZONS) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]
  
  # stack the two forecast columns (lasso, post_lasso) under each other
  for (m in colnames(r$pred)) {
    forecast_long <- rbind(forecast_long,
                           data.frame(target_date = r$target_date,
                                      origin_date = r$origin_date,
                                      h = h,
                                      model = m,
                                      forecast = as.numeric(r$pred[, m]),
                                      actual = as.numeric(r$actual),
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
}
rownames(forecast_long) <- NULL

# relabel post as post_lasso in the saved table only (results keeps "post")
forecast_long$model[forecast_long$model == "post"] <- "post_lasso"

# sanity checks: expected size, no NAs, date columns still Dates
stopifnot(nrow(forecast_long) == length(HORIZONS) * 2 * nprev,
          !anyNA(forecast_long),
          inherits(forecast_long$target_date, "Date"),
          inherits(forecast_long$origin_date, "Date"),
          setequal(unique(forecast_long$model), c("lasso", "post_lasso")))

# save the table through here::here()
dir.create(here::here(OUT_DIR), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(forecast_long, here::here(OUT_DIR, paste0("forecasts_", DATASET, ".rds")))
```

## Write results to CSV

```{r}
samples <- c(official = "main_data_official", self = "main_data_self",
             official_us = "extended_data_official", self_us = "extended_data_self")

for (s in names(samples)) {
  f <- readRDS(here::here(OUT_DIR, paste0("forecasts_", samples[[s]], ".rds")))
  f$sample <- s
  f <- f[, c("sample", "model", "h", "origin_date", "target_date", "forecast", "actual")]
  write.csv(f, here::here(OUT_DIR, paste0("forecasts_lasso_", s, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
for (s in names(samples)) {
  res <- readRDS(here::here(OUT_DIR, paste0("results_lasso_", samples[[s]], ".rds")))

  diag <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res), function(nm) {
    r <- res[[nm]]
    data.frame(sample = s, h = as.numeric(sub("h", "", nm)),
               origin_date = r$origin_date, target_date = r$target_date,
               lambda = r$lambda, pos = r$pos, r$support)
  }))

  write.csv(diag, here::here(OUT_DIR, paste0("tuning_path_lasso_", s, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# 11. Analysis

```{r analysis-against-random-walk}
# random walk benchmark: forecast of target at t+h is inflation at origin t
# (Y[, 1] is the inflation column, matching indice = 1)
err.tab <- NULL

for (h in HORIZONS) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]
  
  # inflation at each origin date
  rw <- Y[match(r$origin_date, dates), 1]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(rw))
  
  # forecasts for LASSO, Post and RW side by side, then errors against actual
  fc <- cbind(r$pred, rw = rw)
  e <- r$actual - fc
  
  err.tab <- rbind(err.tab,
                   data.frame(h = h,
                              model = colnames(fc),
                              RMSE = sqrt(colMeans(e^2)),
                              MAE = colMeans(abs(e)),
                              stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
rownames(err.tab) <- NULL

# ratios to the random walk at the same horizon (achieve <1 to beat RW)
rw.row <- match(paste(err.tab$h, "rw"), paste(err.tab$h, err.tab$model))
err.tab$RMSE_ratio <- err.tab$RMSE / err.tab$RMSE[rw.row]
err.tab$MAE_ratio <- err.tab$MAE / err.tab$MAE[rw.row]
err.tab
```
```{r lasso-vs-post}
# compare on all origins, and on origins where Post-LASSO is a genuine OLS refit
lp.tab <- NULL
for (h in HORIZONS) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]
  e.lasso <- r$actual - r$pred[, "lasso"]
  e.post <- r$actual - r$pred[, "post"]
  
  # origins where Post-LASSO is the OLS refit on the support
  ols <- r$support[, "empty"] == 0 & r$support[, "large"] == 0
  
  lp.tab <- rbind(lp.tab,
                  data.frame(h = h,
                             RMSE_lasso = sqrt(mean(e.lasso^2)),
                             RMSE_post = sqrt(mean(e.post^2)),
                             ratio_post_to_lasso = sqrt(mean(e.post^2)) / sqrt(mean(e.lasso^2)),
                             n_ols = sum(ols),
                             ratio_ols_only = sqrt(mean(e.post[ols]^2)) / sqrt(mean(e.lasso[ols]^2))))
}
lp.tab
```

```{r empty-support-check}
# counts of empty and above-n/2 supports at every horizon
flag.tab <- NULL
for (h in HORIZONS) {
  s <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]$support
  flag.tab <- rbind(flag.tab,
                    data.frame(h = h,
                               n_empty = sum(s[, "empty"] == 1),
                               n_large = sum(s[, "large"] == 1),
                               share_empty = mean(s[, "empty"] == 1),
                               share_large = mean(s[, "large"] == 1),
                               of = nprev))
}
flag.tab

# runs of consecutive empty origins at each horizon: where they start, end and how long
run.tab <- NULL
for (h in HORIZONS) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", h)]]
  e <- r$support[, "empty"] == 1
  rl <- rle(e)
  ends <- cumsum(rl$lengths)
  starts <- ends - rl$lengths + 1
  hit <- which(rl$values)
  if (length(hit) > 0) {
    run.tab <- rbind(run.tab,
                     data.frame(h = h,
                                first_origin = r$origin_date[starts[hit]],
                                last_origin = r$origin_date[ends[hit]],
                                length = rl$lengths[hit]))
  }
}
run.tab

# stripe plot: red marks origins with an empty support, one row per horizon
dts <- c(results$h12$origin_date, results$h1$origin_date)
plot(NULL, xlim = range(dts), ylim = c(0.5, length(HORIZONS) + 0.5),
     xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n", xlab = "origin date", ylab = "", main = "Empty LASSO support")
axis(2, at = seq_along(HORIZONS), labels = paste("h =", HORIZONS), las = 1)

# ticks labelled as years
yrs <- seq(as.Date(format(min(dts), "%Y-01-01")), max(dts), by = "2 years")
axis(1, at = yrs, labels = format(yrs, "%Y"))

for (k in seq_along(HORIZONS)) {
  r <- results[[paste0("h", HORIZONS[k])]]
  e <- r$support[, "empty"] == 1
  if (any(e)) points(r$origin_date[e], rep(k, sum(e)), col = "red", pch = 15)
}
```
